style_line: Flanders, Christmas 1914, a frozen winter world.

location.where_when: British front-line breastwork trench opposite Frelinghien / Christmas morning 1914, dawn

light.colour_key: cold steel-blue winter light, warm orange brazier glow at night

char_sgt_harris.name: the British sergeant
char_sgt_harris.description: Sergeant Albert Harris, a hard 42-year-old British regular soldier with a weathered lined face, grey stubble, a thick dark moustache, deep-set eyes, a khaki soft service cap, three sergeant's chevrons on the sleeve, a goatskin jerkin over the khaki tunic

costumes.cap_on: khaki soft cap, goatskin jerkin over the khaki tunic, three chevrons
costumes.cap_off: bareheaded, the khaki soft cap in his hand, goatskin jerkin over the khaki tunic, three chevrons

char_thomas_hale.name: the young British private
char_thomas_hale.description: Private Thomas Hale, a lean 20-year-old English infantryman with a pale freckled face, short sandy-brown hair, light grey eyes, a khaki 1914 soft service cap with ear flaps, khaki 1902 service-dress tunic with brass buttons, 1908 webbing, muddy puttees, a long khaki greatcoat

costumes.service: khaki soft cap, long khaki greatcoat open over the tunic, every brass tunic button in place
costumes.button_cut: khaki soft cap, long khaki greatcoat open over the tunic, the top right brass tunic button cut off

characters.action: Thomas stands at the ladder, rifle in hand
Harris crouches on the fire step looking up
Thomas kneels on the parapet, looking back down
